output.summary: The backlog growth is mostly self-inflicted by the close quota. First-contact demand rose only 4%, and Payroll adds about 380 first-contact tickets a month. Capacity is flat and closes per agent rose from 11.7 to 19, so low effort does not explain it. Splits, duplicates and reopens drive the growth, and agents are cherry-picking quick wins. The Billing-Compliance pod has no quota and stayed stable. Team C's partial fix cut its reopens, and the audit log rules out a reopen-rule artifact. Resignations are confounded by a competitor's higher pay and the deferred pay review. Engineering bugs may contribute but are unquantified. Suspend the quota and use quality measures. Classify the aged tickets next. Do not raise the quota or commit to irreversible headcount yet.
